enemies.name: Ink Wretch
abilities: Smudge: blurs one letter hint for a turn
enemies.description: A small stain of spilled ink given restless life.

enemies.name: Syllable Wisp
abilities: Echo: repeats your last word, breaking your combo streak
enemies.description: A flickering light that mimics whatever it last heard spoken.

enemies.name: Anagram Shade
enemies.description: A shifting shadow that never holds the same shape twice.

enemies.name: Punctuation Fiend
abilities: Interrupt: cuts your next submitted word short by one letter
enemies.description: A jagged little pest that delights in cutting sentences off.

enemies.name: Grammar Golem
abilities: Stone Sentence: hardens for a turn, +50% defense
enemies.description: A hulking construct built from misused modifiers.

enemies.name: The Lexicon Warden
abilities: Word Ban: forbids one letter from being played for a turn
enemies.description: Ancient guardian of the vault's final word, bound to defend it to the last letter.
